approved_definition_context: EuclideanSpace real Fin n is ordinary real Euclidean n-space with its Euclidean norm and Borel measurable structure. stdGaussian is the canonical centered law with variance-one independent orthonormal coordinates.
WithLp.ofLp exposes the coordinate vector. Matrix m n real is a finite real array. Matrix.vecMulVec w v has entry w_i v_j, so its repeated-vector case is the rank-one matrix of coordinate products.

Matrix.one is the identity matrix. Scalar multiplication multiplies every matrix entry. The chosen norm is the Euclidean L2 operator norm on finite matrices, with the usual finite-dimensional topology.

Set.indicator retains the indicated function on its set and is zero elsewhere. Integrable means a.e. strong measurability and finite norm integral in the indicated measure. All integrals are real or matrix Bochner integrals.

The real dimension r is the cast of the positive natural dimension q+1. Real.log is the natural logarithm on positive arguments. The displayed integral defining the real scalar uses the original Gaussian measure.
